transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 1726 Seven Springs Drive?
Yes, this is 1726 Seven Springs Drive. We’re safe, two people here, no water inside, and we don’t need help right now.
Thank you for confirming your safety and current status. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Two people are here. No one can’t come to the phone.

Thank you for letting us know about the people here. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No one here can’t leave on their own. No wheelchair or medical needs.
Understood, no one here can’t leave on their own. Is there water inside the home right now?
No water inside. Just two people here, no need for help.
Thank you for the update. Stay alert and safe. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
No truck, no boat, no free seats.
Understood, no truck, boat, or free seats available. Let me read that back: 2 people; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Yes. Two people. No water inside.
Thank you for confirming your situation. I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
